_comment: Central tuning config for tcgDataSynth. Edit and re-run; scripts read this at runtime. Each scene type has its OWN params under 'layouts'.

holo._comment: Holo diffraction-flash. angle_gain: flash-band motion vs view angle. pattern_gain: spatial break-up. sharpness: flash threshold. emit: peak flash brightness. darken: base darkening between flashes.

table._comment: max_cards, allow_overlap (~15% vs spaced), out_of_frustum ('keep'=render unlabeled | 'remove'=don't render).
